point: # The controls spec of mc-motor-1 (the motor bench) for the panel shop (lib/panel-shop.md): written by the core 2026-11-08 from dm-motor-starter-cell's connections.csv and circuits.csv and the first lab's channel map (virtual-school manifest
kind: fixture 1). One row per point the panel must serve.

rating: 30 A feeder (Assumption (B): the lab's branch circuit is not on file)
note: PE arrives with the supply through the gland plate

rating: control transformer sized for the PSU (60 W), the safety relay and the coils: 100 VA class (Assumption (B): the sum is on the panel's loads; NFPA 79 9.1.1 control circuit from a transformer; 9.1.3 secondary grounded)
device: panel-1.t1 (xfmr-control: elec pin 5; not yet built)
note: added 2026-11-09: the solver found pm-motor-starter's PSU (85–264 VAC in) on 480 V with no transformer; the PSU's input is fed from the secondary through a 2-pole breaker (Q2 becomes 2-pole, or a fused primary per NEC 430.72(C))

rating: 0.37 kW, 0.91 A FLA (motor-iec71-370w ratings.csv), direct on line
note: one motor branch: disconnect, branch breaker, contactor K1, thermal overload F1 (0.8 to 1.2 A); the panel's 480 V receptacle p-m1 to the motor's cable
through the bench's I/O block io-1 X1 A

rating: stop category 0, PL d / category 3 (Assumption (A): for EM)
note: the station's e-stop to a safety relay in the panel; the relay's monitored output drops K1 and reports estop_ok to the controller (X2 A)

the panel tells the controller the e-stop chain is healthy; moved from X2 A 2026-11-11 (request panel-1 3.b): port-x2's one cable goes to the station's reset, and X3 is a free input port; from an A-coded wall port of the panel, wired from io-1's pin 1 (U_S) through the relay's monitored contact back to pin 4

standard: NFPA 79 9.1.1 (control circuit voltage); ELR-021 (coil = its supply)
note: the controller's run output, io-1 X7 A (port-x7 pin 4; request panel-1 3.a: X5 and X6 carry the station's cables, X7 is a free output port), energises K1 through the safety relay's output, from an A-coded wall port of the panel; the output port's return pin is io-1's NOT ON FILE (A) (its spec: the supply pins of X5 to X8)

standard: IEC 61131-2 type 3; IEC 60204-1 7.3 (the overload device switches the motor off)
note: X4 A (port-x4 pin 4). Was ol_ok on 95-96 until 2026-11-11 (request panel-1 3.d): 95-96 (N.C.) stays hardwired in K1's coil chain, as pm-motor-starter has it, so a trip drops K1 with no controller in the path; the controller reads the trip on 97-98
X4 B (port-x4 pin 2): run feedback; ol_trip and k1_aux share one A-coded wall port of the panel to io-1 port-x4, each contact fed from the port's own pin 1 (U_S), never from the panel's 24 V bus

standard: NFPA 79 10.3 (indicator colours: white or green for running)

rating: 2.4 A supply shared: I/O block US/UL, lamps, coils (psu-24v-2a4)
note: L-coded M12 from the panel's p-x2
the controller in the panel to the bench's I/O block from p-x1
A-coded M12 from the panel's p-x3 to the station's e-stop

rating: bench and motor frame bonding to the panel's PE
